scope: Deductive verification of the two production document-publication state functions after TypeScript erasure. This is not proof of the complete factory, caller ownership, browser publication or effect coverage.
preconditions: The private record has an arbitrary prototype and owns writable data properties for the generation and four Boolean flags.
The retained old generation is an ordinary JavaScript object distinct from the state record.
Other heap resources are protected by the verifier framing discipline; caller ownership and native adapters need separate proofs.
TypeScript erasure, extraction, Gillian JavaScript semantics, verifier and solver remain trusted.
